findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before granting document access
findings.body: When a user's tenant differs from the document's tenant, `canReadDocument` now returns `true` unconditionally. This bypasses the previous tenant-boundary check and permits cross-tenant document access.

findings.title: [P1] Preserve tenant isolation when authorizing document reads
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now authorizes every request. Any input where `userTenant !== documentTenant` permits cross-tenant document access, bypassing the function’s established tenant-boundary check.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before granting document access
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now authorizes every request. Any user whose `userTenant` differs from a document’s `documentTenant` can read that cross-tenant document, completely bypassing tenant isolation.
